what: an old book, a quill and an inkpot together: the open book lies flat, seen from the front and a little from above, its two pages fanned open in a shallow V; crossing over it steeply on a diagonal is a large quill pen made entirely of old dark bronze metal: hard and rigid, with sharp metal edges, its vane cast in bold ridges, deep coppery brown metal, darker than gold and never yellow, with bright copper highlights glinting on its hard metal ridges, its nib at the lower left, its tip at the upper right, rising well above the book and a little longer than the book is wide; and beside the book at the lower right, touching it, a squat round inkpot of black glazed clay with a wide mouth. The book is well used: dark brown leather covers scuffed pale at the corners, the corners of the pages curled and dog-eared, the page edges uneven, one dark brown ribbon hanging out. The pages are clean, pale cream and blank.
colours: A quill of old dark bronze metal, deep coppery brown with dull copper-brown highlights on its ridges, dark brown in its grooves; dark chocolate-brown leather covers; clean pale cream pages; a black glazed inkpot with one white glint.
must_show: open old book with blank pages
large quill of shining bronze METAL (not a bird feather) crossing the book on a diagonal
squat black inkpot touching the book
well used: scuffed covers, uneven page edges

what: a scholar's desk at night, seen close: an old open book lying on dark oak boards, its pages fanned open, clean, pale cream and blank; across the book on a diagonal lies a large quill pen made entirely of old dark bronze metal: hard and rigid, with sharp metal edges, its vane cast in bold ridges, deep coppery brown metal, darker than gold and never yellow, with bright copper highlights glinting on its hard metal ridges, its nib at the lower left, its tip at the upper right; a squat round inkpot of black glazed clay touches the book at the lower right. The book is well used: dark brown leather covers scuffed pale at the corners, dog-eared page corners, uneven page edges. Warm golden light falls on the book from the upper left, so the pale pages are the brightest thing in the picture; behind, the room is deep brown shadow with the dim shapes of shelves.
colours: Clean pale cream pages; a quill of old dark bronze metal, deep coppery brown with dull copper-brown highlights, dark brown in its grooves; dark chocolate-brown leather; a black inkpot; dark oak boards; deep brown shadow behind.
must_show: open old book with blank pages in the middle
large quill of shining bronze METAL across it
black inkpot
bright pages against a dark background

what: a small toy bath duck made of soft yellow rubber, round and plump, sitting upright, seen from the side facing left: a round head on a round body, a short flat orange beak, a small tail tip turned up at the back, and a little moulded wing on its side. It is a plain old toy with no markings, and it looks harmless and adorable. Its one visible eye is a small glossy black bead holding a single hard white glint, and it looks sidelong straight at the viewer: the faintest hint that it is not as harmless as it looks.
colours: Bright buttercup-yellow rubber with soft pale yellow highlights and warm golden-yellow shading; a short flat orange beak; a glossy black eye with one white glint.
must_show: a round yellow rubber toy duck seen from the side
orange beak
black eye with a hard white glint
looks adorable and harmless

what: a dungeon corridor of dark old stone blocks, seen close and low, at the height of a small toy. Sitting alone in the very middle of the stone floor is a small toy bath duck of bright yellow rubber, round and plump, seen from the side facing left: a round head on a round body, a short flat orange beak, a small tail tip turned up, a little moulded wing. Its one visible eye is a small glossy black bead holding a single hard white glint. A warm shaft of light from the upper left falls on the duck alone, so it glows bright yellow against the deep shadow round it; the corridor runs away behind it into darkness. It looks harmless, adorable and out of place, waiting to be picked up.
colours: Bright buttercup-yellow rubber duck with a short flat orange beak and a glossy black eye; dark grey-brown dungeon stone; deep black-brown shadow behind.
must_show: yellow rubber toy duck large in the middle
orange beak, black eye with a glint
dark dungeon stone round it
bright duck against a dark background

what: an old brass miner's lantern standing in front of the mouth of a cave. The lantern is tall and sturdy: a round brass base, a glass chimney held in four thick brass bars, a brass cap on top with a big carrying ring. Inside the glass burns a flame of eerie phosphor green, and the whole glass glows the same cold bright green. Behind it, framing it, is the mouth of a cave: a rough arch of big boulders of warm brown-grey stone, twice as tall as the lantern, its opening filled with solid pitch-black darkness, so the green glow shines out against the black. The bottom of the arch is a straight row of boulders, level with the lantern's base.
colours: Warm polished brass, golden-brown with bright yellow-white highlights and dark brown shading; a cold, bright, eerie phosphor-green flame and glow in the glass; warm brown-grey boulders; a pitch-black cave opening.
must_show: brass miner's lantern
eerie bright green glow in its glass
cave mouth: rough grey rock arch, pitch-black opening behind the lantern

what: the mouth of a dark cave, seen from just outside: a rough arch of grey rock runs round the edges of the picture, and inside it is pitch-black darkness. In the very middle, standing on a flat rock at the cave's threshold, is an old brass miner's lantern: a round brass base, a glass chimney held in four thick brass bars, a brass cap with a big carrying ring. Inside the glass burns a flame of eerie phosphor green, the brightest thing in the picture, and its cold green light spills over the brass and the nearest rocks, fading into the black of the cave behind.
colours: Warm polished brass with bright highlights; a cold, bright, eerie phosphor-green flame and glow; grey rock lit green near the lantern; pitch-black cave darkness behind.
must_show: brass miner's lantern in the middle
eerie green glow
dark cave mouth round it
bright lantern against black

what: an iron cowbell hanging from its collar. The bell is shaped like a flat-sided trapezoid: seen from the front its outline has four straight sides, narrow at the top and wide at the bottom, with square corners, and it is made of dark hammered iron plates riveted along its edges; a round iron clapper hangs just below its open bottom. Its outline has no curves at all. Above it, a broad collar strap of black-and-white spotted cowhide with the hair still on, as wide as the bell's top, hangs in a big U shape as tall as the bell itself, both ends fixed to the bell's top with a dark iron loop: bold black patches on bright white hide. From the open bottom of the bell comes a faint hellish glow, white-hot yellow in the middle and deep red at its edges, which lights the bell's lower edges warm red, as if the bell has come from somewhere hot.
colours: Neutral dark charcoal-grey iron with bright pale grey worn edges and rivets; a broad collar strap of black-and-white spotted cowhide, bold black patches on bright white; a dark iron buckle; a faint glow from inside the bell, yellow-white in the middle and red at its edges.
must_show: square iron cowbell: flat sides, square corners, mouth down
broad black-and-white spotted cowhide strap looping over it, big enough to read
faint hellish glow from inside the bell

what: a tall stone archway in a dark dungeon wall, its opening filled with a glowing swirl of hellish red light. Standing in the middle of the opening, facing the viewer, is an ordinary farm cow: a real black-and-white dairy cow with a pink nose, short curved pale horns and an iron bell on a strap round her neck, calmly chewing and looking out with mild, puzzled eyes. She is completely calm and unharmed, and plainly out of place, which is the joke. Her front is lit by soft light from the upper left, and the red light behind outlines her.
colours: A black-and-white dairy cow with bold black patches on bright white, a pink nose; a glowing hellish red light in the doorway; dark grey stone wall round it.
must_show: a real black-and-white cow in the middle, facing the viewer
a doorway full of red light behind her
calm, comic, unharmed cow

what: a black knight's great helm resting on his broadsword on a short piece of a wooden bridge. The piece of bridge is three thick old planks of dark weathered oak lying side by side, seen from the front and a little from above, only a little wider than the helm, their ends sawn straight. Across the planks on a diagonal lies a broadsword, hilt at the lower left, point at the upper right. On the middle of the planks, resting on the sword's blade, sits the great helm, large, half as tall as the whole group: a flat-topped barrel helm painted glossy jet-black, with one narrow eye slit across its face and a few round breathing holes, still and empty, its black paint catching bright white highlights on its top and edges.
colours: A glossy jet-black painted helm with bright white highlights; a broadsword of bright pale steel with a dark iron crossguard and a dark brown leather grip; dark weathered oak planks, grey-brown, with darker grain.
must_show: black great helm with an eye slit, large
broadsword lying diagonally under it
short piece of wooden bridge planking
helm empty and still

what: a small old wooden footbridge over a stream in a misty wood, seen close from the front at the level of its planks. On the middle of the bridge a broadsword lies across the planks on a diagonal, and resting on the sword's blade sits a black knight's great helm: a flat-topped barrel helm of blackened iron with one narrow eye slit and a few round breathing holes, still and empty. Behind the bridge the wood is pale grey-green morning mist with only the faint shapes of trees, so the black helm stands out dark against it, its worn edges catching the light.
colours: Blackened iron helm with bright pale steel-white worn edges; a bright pale steel broadsword with a dark iron crossguard; grey-brown weathered oak planks; pale grey-green misty wood behind.
must_show: black great helm in the middle, on the bridge
broadsword under it
small wooden bridge
dark helm against a pale misty background

what: a pair of cupped hands floating in the air by themselves, held together, palms up, seen from the front and a little from above, holding up the Philosopher's Stone. The hands are a grown person's, strong and weathered, fingers together and curved round the stone. Each wrist ends in a short turned-back cuff of dark blue wool, no longer than a thumb, and below the two cuffs there is nothing at all, only the flat backdrop. In the hollow of the hands sits one large gem, roughly round, cut with big flat facets, glowing from within: blazing gold-white at its heart, deep red toward its edges, so bright that the fingers round it are lit red-gold. The warm light of sunrise falls on the hands from the left.
colours: A glowing gem, blazing gold-white at its heart and deep red toward its edges; red-gold light on the fingers; weather-beaten light tan skin; dark blue wool cuffs.
must_show: two cupped hands, palms up
a large faceted gem glowing gold-white at its heart, red at its edges
warm sunrise light on the hands
must_not_show: arms reaching up from the bottom of the picture

what: two cupped hands held up together, palms up, seen close from the front, holding up the Philosopher's Stone against a sunrise. The hands are a grown person's, strong and weathered, in dark blue wool sleeves that run down out of the bottom of the picture. In the hollow of the hands sits one large gem, roughly round, cut with big flat facets, glowing from within: blazing gold-white at its heart, deep red toward its edges, the brightest thing in the picture, its light warm on the fingers. Far behind, dark rolling hills with the tiny roofs of a village lie under a sky that is still the deep blue of dawn, with a band of gold sunrise along the horizon.
colours: A gem glowing gold-white at its heart and deep red toward its edges, red-gold light on the fingers; weather-beaten light tan skin; dark blue wool sleeves; dark hills; a deep blue dawn sky with a gold band of sunrise low down.
must_show: two cupped hands holding a glowing red-gold gem in the middle
the gem is the brightest thing
sunrise sky and far hills behind
